## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --workspace` pass
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` (Unreleased) updated where relevant
- [ ] No real session data, tokens or personal paths in code, tests or screenshots
- [ ] UI changes checked in compact and full-screen mode, in a dark and a light theme
